name: Mantle
_about: A MANTLE: a great rectangle of cloth wrapped round the body over the arms -- the Greek himation and chlamys, the Roman toga and palla -- as a cape over the shoulders and the mantle hanging from them clear of the arms down to `to`, both OPEN where the wrap is not: `centre` the middle of the cloth round the body (0 the front, 180 the back; off the back, it is wrapped from one side and pinned or tucked on the other), `span` how far round it goes. A hem band may border it (the toga's purple).
